item.title: Sheriff: Edwardsburg-area boy, 12, killed in storm Friday
item.description: At least four people are dead, including a preteen boy, and more than a dozen were injured after a strong stormed ripped through Southwest Michigan Friday evening, spawning West Michigan’s first deadly tornado in more than four decades.

item.title: Meet Emma Genevieve Gillette: The first lady of Michigan’s parks
item.description: Percy James Hoffmaster was named the first park superintendent for Michigan’s Department of Conservation, but it was his friend and former classmate, Emma Genevieve Gillette, who led the push establishing new parks.

item.title: Family of man shot, killed by GRPD calls for change at vigil
item.description: As a community continues to mourn the loss of a man shot and killed by Grand Rapids police last month, they’re also calling for a change in policing.

item.title: Union City community remembers those killed by tornado: 'She was a good friend'
item.description: Three people were killed Friday when a powerful EF3 tornado touched down near Union Lake sending shockwaves through a small community. One of the victims, a 65-year-old woman, is now being remembered by family and friends.

item.title: Three Rivers, Union City districts closed Monday after tornado
item.description: Three Rivers Community Schools and Union City Community Schools will be closed to students Monday, days after tornadoes ripped through the communities.

item.title: Iran names Mojtaba Khamenei to succeed his father as supreme leader and Saudi sharpens warning
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates (AP) — Mojtaba Khamenei, a son of Iran's late supreme leader, has been named as the Islamic Republic's next ruler, authorities announced Monday, as Tehran widened its attacks across the Mideast to strike oil and water facilities crucial to its desert sheikdoms. item.title: Police: 1 arrested, 1 hurt after Dave & Buster's shooting
item.description: One person is in custody after a shooting at a Kentwood Dave & Buster's injured at least one person Saturday night, police say.

item.title: Deputies investigating tire tracks on Paw Paw-area golf course
item.description: Deputies say a Paw Paw-area golf course green was destroyed when a vehicle drove on it, gouging muddy tire marks into its surface.

item.title: Tornado near Edwardsburg rated EF1 by National Weather Service
item.description: The tornado that tore through Edwardsburg, Michigan on Friday has been rated an EF1 by the National Weather Service with maximum winds of 95 mph detected.

item.title: ‘Despair’: Survivors recount Union City tornado
item.description: Two days after a deadly tornado tore through the Union City area, neighbors and volunteers from near and far came together to support families who lost homes and loved ones.
